create_DiffWave_model: create a DiffWave neural vocoder model from a Config object with noise schedules and training parameters
train_DiffWave_step: run a single training step on the DiffWave model given spectrograms and waveforms to compute loss and update weights
generate_audio_DiffWave: generate audio waveforms from mel spectrograms using the DiffWave model's reverse diffusion process
compute_DiffWave_validation_loss: compute validation losses for the DiffWave model on a batch of spectrograms and waveforms
get_DiffWave_complexity: get the FLOPS and parameter count of the DiffWave model using the ptflops complexity counter
